JonXL 的 Multi Wan2.2 T2I / T2V / I2V + 剪辑扩展器工作流程（+升级和插值）

(+ 无限重用最后一帧生成)

  • 如果您是经验丰富的 ComfyUI 用户，请考虑在此处使用 V4：https://civitai.com/models/1872180?modelVersionId=2122194

*将节点“rg Three-comfy”降级到较低版本，例如1.0.25052900，因为他们的新错误阻止组显示在控制（绕过）面板中*

*V2a - 更新，修复了“始终调整大小”错误，现在调整大小切换可以工作

一种易于使用的多用途工作流程，用于使用 2-3 个简单的切换来生成文本到视频和（无限）图像到视频。

配置所有模型一次，然后在生成模式之间轻松切换。

（参见通过帧扩展生成的 25 秒剪辑的示例视频）

请继续关注未来的更新。

专业提示：

结合使用我的快速视频拼接器工作流程，可以快速将两个（生成的）视频剪辑拼接在一起（冲洗并重复）：

https://civitai.com/models/1864873

版本：

V1 - 具有所有模式的示例

V2 - 现在仅使用 1 个可刷新的图像加载器 + 视频帧转储（用于手动帧拾取）.. 推荐。

特点：

  • 允许生成 T2V 和 I2V（使用单个切换）

  • 允许生成分辨率高达 1920x1080 的单个文本到图像

  • 通过使用最后一帧作为输入帧，允许无限视频生成（对于 V1，打开开关并生成您想要的内容:)）

  • 包括放大和帧插值

  • 支持（每个切换）简单调整输入图像的大小和重新缩放，而不是裁剪

  • Multi Lora loading

  • 输入图像的剪辑视觉（尽管默认情况下禁用）

  • Sage 对绩效的关注

对于无限视频生成非常有用，只需更改提示并在剪辑渲染后单击“生成按钮”，即可开始使用新剪辑的最后一帧。

  • 如果需要，如果您不喜欢最后生成的剪辑，您也可以手动选择最后一帧。如果您想要再次使用最新生成的帧，请使用“重置”。

  • 切换可以在“步骤 3 - 选择参数”中找到。

  • 您也可以选择在步骤 5“提示”上方的控制面板中快速启用或禁用帧插值和放大。

  • 确保加载随机图像（可能是此工作流程 zip 存档附带的图像）以避免“加载图像”节点出现初始错误。 （虽然文本 2 图像或视频不需要图像，但 ComfyUI 喜欢抱怨它）

  • 此模型中使用的示例 Lora 可以在此处找到：https://civitai.com/models/1862320/wan22-t2v-lora-cartoon-style )

  • 此工作流程不会将视频拼接在一起，但您可以使用我的快速视频拼接器工作流程将视频快速拼接在一起：https://civitai.com/models/1864873

该 zip 文件 (V1) 包含一个工作流程和三张示例图像。

  • 工作流程已预先配置为图像到视频，并启用帧扩展，960x720x81 帧。

  • 您还可以放入示例图像以获取带有帧扩展的 T2I、T2V、I2V、I2V 的预配置。

  • 对于 T2I，建议安装以下 custom_node 以使用“res_2s”+“bong tangent”采样器：https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF

----

o.en:
JonXL's Multi Wan2.2 T2I / T2V / I2V + Clip Extender Workflow (+Upscaling & Interpolation)

(+ infinite reuse last frame generation)

  • Please consider using V4 here if you are an experienced ComfyUI User:https://civitai.com/models/1872180?modelVersionId=2122194

*Downgrade node 'rgthree-comfy' to a lower version like1.0.25052900, since their new bug prevents groups showing up in the control (bypass) panel*

*V2a - Updated, Fixed the "always resize" bug, now the resize toggle works

A multipurpose easy to use workflow for generating text to video and (infinite) image to video, using 2-3 simple toggles.

Configure all models once and then easily switch between generation modes.

(See example video of a 25 second clip generated through frame extension)

Stay tuned for future updates.

Pro tip:

Use my Quick Video Stitcher workflow in conjunction to quickly stitch two (generated) video clips together (rinse and repeat):

https://civitai.com/models/1864873

Versions:

V1 - Has examples for all modes

V2 - Now only uses 1 Image loader that can be refreshed + Video Frame Dump (for manual frame picking) .. recommended.

Features:

  • Allows for T2V and I2V generation (using a single toggle)

  • Allows for single text to image generation with resolution up to 1920x1080

  • Allows for infinite video generation, by using the last frame as the input frame (for V1 turn on the toggle and generate to your heart's content :) )

  • Includes upscaling and frame interpolation

  • Supports (per toggle) simple resize and rescaling of input images instead of cropping

  • Multi Lora loading

  • Clip Vision for input image (though disabled by default)

  • Sage Attention for performance

Very useful for infinite video generation, just change the prompt and click on the "Generate button" once a clip has rendered, to start using the last frame for a new clip.

  • If needed, you can manually select the last frame too, if you didn't like the last clip generated. Use 'reset' if you want the latest generated frame again.

  • Toggles can be found in "Step 3 - Choose parameters".

  • Optionally you can quickly enable or disable frame interpolation and upscaling in the control panel above step 5 "Prompt".

  • Make sure to load a random image (perhaps the one that came with this workflow zip archive) to avoid the initial error for the "Load image" node. (while the image is not needed for text 2 image or video, ComfyUI likes to complains about it)

  • The example Lora used in this model can be found here:https://civitai.com/models/1862320/wan22-t2v-lora-cartoon-style )

  • This workflow does not stitch videos together, but you can use my Quick Video Stitcher Workflow to quickly stitch videos together :https://civitai.com/models/1864873

The zip file (V1) contains one workflow and three example images.

  • The workflow is preconfigured for Image to Video with Frame Extending on, 960x720x81 frames.

  • You can also drop in the example images to get a pre-configuration for  T2I, T2V, I2V, I2V with frame extending.

  • For T2I it is recommend to install the following custom_node to use "res_2s" + "bong tangent" sampler:https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF
